plan.build_control: Same /tmp/owrt-core-release/ubusd source path, SDK, compiler, working directory and flags as R103; no production installation.
plan.hypothesis: One shared empty 4096-byte receive buffer removes per-idle-client retention without per-serial-message reallocations. Partial frames and descriptor marks remain owned by their clients. Large bodies remain separately owned.
plan.statistical_unit: Independent physical-router block; paired ratios within a block. Requests are not independent repetitions.
plan.analysis: Exploratory screen, no superiority or equivalence verdict. Preserve every adverse direction and complete raw archive. No pooling older runs.
plan.retention_rule: Correctness failure rejects candidate. In any CPU lane, >=3/4 positive before-pairs and median >1%, or p99 median >5% with >=3/4 positive pairs, requires independent frozen recheck before retention. Other adverse cells remain explicit. Memory counters are diagnostics, not precise PSS/peak.
plan.failure_rule: Stop on any identity, correctness, health, cleanup or collection failure; preserve the failed window.
plan.production: C throughout; private mount/PID/net namespace, guarded lifetime and cleanup per window.

method: Paired exploratory blocks; full per-run values; no confidence or equivalence claim
scope: ubusd only, private router namespace, 10 lanes; object counts (64, 128)
memory_note: End-of-matrix proc counters; not PSS, precise RSS, per-lane peak or whole-system memory
